eips.title: Fast Execution Payload Broadcast
eips.summary: PFI'd for Hegota consideration as a fast execution payload broadcast EIP replacing Block-in-Blobs.

moments.context: Kamil introduced 8411 as a new EIP focused on chunked gossip for faster payload propagation, requesting PFI for Hegota.
Kamil presented simulation results showing P95 latency dropping from about 6 seconds to about 2 seconds for 1MB payloads with 4000 hosts.
Stokes asked about forward compatibility with erasure coding; Kamil said additions would need a separate future EIP.
Toni said it is a simpler subset of Block-in-Blobs; Ansgar suggested making the CFI decision more towards the end of scoping to allow analysis time.
Stokes confirmed PFI with no objections; asked client teams to incorporate 8411 into their rankings.
In chat, potuz asked for the client-priority list to be redone with 8411 PFI'd, saying both Prysm and Lighthouse had put it up and it was the only S-tier EIP for Prysm.

eips.title: Block-in-Blobs (BiB)
eips.summary: Referenced as the predecessor Block-in-Blobs EIP being effectively replaced by 8411.

moments.context: Kamil explained that 8142 originally proposed reusing data column subnets but iterating led to a dedicated new EIP 8411 instead.
Ethdreamer noted Lighthouse said no on 8142, creating confusion about whether that vote applied to 8411.

eips.title: Block Access List Sidecars
eips.summary: DFI'd for Hegota; Toni noted 8411 largely subsumes its benefits.

moments.context: Toni said 8411 consumes much of Block Access List Sidecars, especially if shipped with an earlier BAL deadline.
Stokes included 8146 in the batch of DFI'd EIPs.

eips.title: BLS withdrawal credential retirement
eips.summary: Lean toward CFI with reduced scope removing forced exits of 0x00 validators; final CFI deferred to next call pending EIP update.

moments.context: Terence flagged that Prysm's A-tier ranking was conditional on removing the forced exit part; with exits included it would be DFI.
Stokes opened discussion on 8365 scope; NC asked if any client team objects to removing the exit component.
Potuz said Prysm would DFI if forced exits remain, strongly opposing them; Lighthouse shares this view.
NC explained deposit guard mechanics: new 0x00 validators would be dropped but top-ups to existing ones still processed.
Matthew Keil proposed writing a two-fork EIP with deposit closure in Hegota and forced exits in I-Star.
Potuz suggested hardcoding an epoch a year after Hegota for forced exits to avoid backtracking concerns.
Stokes summarized alignment on CFI with reduced scope; asked NC to get the updated PR merged before next call.

eips.title: Remove `deposit` and `eth1data` fields
eips.summary: CFI'd for Hegota as it removes unused deposit and eth1data fields with strong client support.

moments.context: Stokes proposed CFI for 8015 given strong client rankings; no objections were raised.
Justin Traglia urged CFI now; Stokes confirmed CFI, calling it pretty straightforward.

eips.title: Hash-Chain RANDAO
eips.summary: DFI'd for Hegota but acknowledged as important PQ preparatory work that should continue toward I-Star.

moments.context: Kevaundray argued Hash-Chain RANDAO work should continue during Hegota to be ready for I-Star PQ plans, even though DFI'd.
Stokes confirmed DFI for 8321 with the caveat that PQ legwork should start well before I-Star.
Dustin noted 8321 is feasible later and not rate-limiting, supporting DFI but acknowledging its necessity eventually.

eips.title: Tapered Issuance Burn
eips.summary: Issuance burn EIP tabled for today; discussion highlighted that client teams feel unqualified to decide and broader community input is needed.

moments.context: Stokes proposed pulling out 8363 from the DFI batch, saying issuance needs separate consideration given community impact.
Stokes reiterated tabling issuance; noted 3 teams ranked DFI and 3 abstained, reflecting difficulty of the decision.
Potuz argued the community affected is overwhelmingly against and called for outside experts on monetary policy to weigh in.
Ansgar emphasized this is not a conspiracy to delay; the governance process for issuance decisions needs to be defined.
Lightclient asked why not DFI now and separately figure out governance; Stokes said they've run out of time and it could be DFI'd next call.

eips.title: VOPS Profiles for FOCIL Eligibility

moments.context: Soispoke explained 8369 is informational, intended to align specs for FOCIL and Frames interactions.
Multiple participants debated whether it belongs on ACDC or ACDE; Stokes concluded no action needed today, it's orthogonal to scoping.
